items.prompt: לֹא שָׁתָה הָעָם מִמֵּי הַיְאֹר
items.answer: The people did not drink from the waters of the river.

items.prompt: לָקַח דָּוִד אֲבִיגַיִל לְאִשָּׁה וְהִיא אִשָּׁה טוֹבַת שֶׂכֶל
items.answer: David took Abigail to wife, and she was a woman of good understanding.

items.prompt: אֶבְיוֹנֵי הָעָם הֵם צַדִּיקִים
items.answer: The poor of the people are righteous.

items.prompt: לֹא שָׁמַרְנוּ תּוֹרַת יהוה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
items.answer: We have not kept the law of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

items.prompt: עָשָׂה הַשַּׂר כְּמִצְוַת הַמֶּלֶךְ
items.answer: The prince did according to the king's commandment.

items.prompt: וּבְתוֹרַת יהוה לֹא הָלָכְתָּ
items.answer: And in the law of Yahweh thou hast not walked.

items.prompt: אֵלֶּה מִצְוֹת אֱלֹהֵי כָּל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר כָּתַבְתִּי הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה
items.answer: These are the commandments of the God of all the earth which I have written this day.

items.prompt: שָׁכַב הַיֶּלֶד עַל־מִטַּת אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים
items.answer: The boy lay on the bed of the man of God.

items.prompt: בָּא חַיִל גָּדוֹל מִיַּרְכְּתֵי הָאָרֶץ וּמֵאַרְבַּע רוּחוֹת הַשָּׁמָיִם
items.answer: There came a great army from the ends of the earth and from the four winds of heaven.

items.prompt: אָכַלְנוּ מִכָּל־עֵץ הַגָּן
items.answer: We ate of every tree of the garden.

items.prompt: וּמַלְכַּת הָאָרֶץ בַּת אִישׁ גִּבּוֹר חָיִל
items.answer: Now the queen of the land was the daughter of a mighty man of valour.

items.prompt: הָיָה רָעָב בָּאָרֶץ וְאַבְרָם יָרַד מִצְרַיְמָה כִּי כָבֵד הָרָעָב בָּאָרֶץ
items.answer: There was a famine in the land, and Abraham went down into Egypt, for the famine was sore in the land.

items.prompt: תורת יהוה טובה
items.answer: The law of Yahweh is good.

items.prompt: ביום ההוא עשה יהוה ישועה בישראל
items.answer: On that day Yahweh wrought deliverance in Israel.

data.pointed: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא עָשָׂה יְהוָה יְשׁוּעָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל

items.prompt: The great day of Yahweh
items.answer: יוֹם יְהוָה הַגָּדוֹל

items.prompt: The day of Yahweh is great.
items.answer: גָּדוֹל יוֹם יְהוָה

items.prompt: The good queen of the land
items.answer: מַלְכַּת הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה

items.prompt: All the people of the earth
items.answer: כָּל־עַם הָאָרֶץ

items.prompt: All the king's good asses
items.answer: כָּל־חֲמוֹרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ הַטּוֹבִים

items.prompt: The captain (prince) reviewed all the mighty-men of valour and all the people of war.
items.answer: פָּקַד הַשַּׂר אֶת־כָּל־גִּבּוֹרֵי הַחַיִל וְאֶת־כָּל־עַם הַמִּלְחָמָה

items.prompt: In the two-sides of the temple
items.answer: בְּיַרְכְּתֵי הַהֵיכָל

items.prompt: I have gone northward.
items.answer: הָלַכְתִּי צָפוֹנָה

items.prompt: We are gone down to Sheol.
items.answer: יָרַדְנוּ שְׁאוֹלָה

items.prompt: He went towards-the-mountain.
items.answer: הָלַךְ הָהָרָה

items.prompt: We slew the man's ass.
items.answer: הָרַגְנוּ אֶת־חֲמוֹר הָאִישׁ

items.prompt: The people did not drink from the waters of the river, for they (were) blood.
items.answer: לֹא שָׁתָה הָעָם מִמֵּי הַיְאֹר כִּי דָם הֵם

items.prompt: Ye have not kept the commandments of the God of all the earth.
items.answer: לֹא שְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת־מִצְוֹת אֱלֹהֵי כָל־הָאָרֶץ

items.prompt: The spirit of God (was) upon the waters.
items.answer: רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים עַל־הַמָּיִם

items.prompt: God of the spirits (that belong) to all flesh
items.answer: אֱלֹהֵי הָרוּחֹת לְכָל־בָּשָׂר

items.prompt: I have broken down all the walls of the city.
items.answer: נָתַצְתִּי אֶת־כָּל־חוֹמֹת הָעִיר

items.prompt: Thou hast kept the poor of the land from all ill.
items.answer: שָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת־אֶבְיוֹנֵי הָאָרֶץ מִכָּל־רָע

items.prompt: Thou (f.) hast eaten of the tree of the garden.
items.answer: אָכַלְתְּ מֵעֵץ הַגָּן
